      <h3>Global seismic-vessel presence</h3>

      <p>
        An exploratory dashboard summarizing the global AIS presence of
        seismic-classified vessels. Screening categories distinguish patterns
        compatible with transit, port presence and possible acquisition; they
        are analytical classifications rather than verified operational states.
      </p>

      <h3>El Rincón: VMS patterns in a potential fisheries OECM case</h3>

        A descriptive visualization of aggregated Argentine VMS records in and
        around El Rincón from 2005 to 2024. A fixed grid and the AER-2010
        boundary support seasonal comparison without treating recorded
        locations as trawled area or as a compliance assessment.
      </p>
